data.name: Pranesh
data.gender_notes: Pranesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pranesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word Prana, which means 'life' or 'breath'. The suffix -esh denotes 'lord' or 'master'. This name signifies the lord or master of creation, and is often given to a baby as a symbol of the belief that he or she is a divine being. The name Pranesh carries the meaning “Lord of Creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pranesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine creation and life.
data.etymology: Pranesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pranesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
